subject: Distance 1.0.2 and mrds 2.2.4 now on CRAN

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Distance 1.0.2 and mrds 2.2.4 now on CRAN
parts:
Hi listfolk,

New versions of the Distance and mrds R packages are now on CRAN. Binary
packages for Windows/Mac may take a while to appear. Changes are listed
below.

cheers,
--dave


---


Distance 1.0.2 NEWS:

* ds.gof is now deprecated for goodness-of-fit testing. gof_ds is now
preferred.
* add_df_covar_line (actually located in mrds) can now plot probability
density functions for point transects
* bootdht can now use the progress package if installed to give an
estimated time remaining for bootstraps (option
progress_bar="progress"). Alternatively no progress bar can be shown
with progress_bar="none".

mrds 2.2.4 NEWS:

* add_df_covar_line now plots probability density functions for the
point transect case
* warning is no longer raised when truncation is not set but bins are
specified for binned data (it's assumed that the furthest cutpoint is
the truncation)
* AIC/logLik functions now work for all methods
